turns.text: Hello, thanks for coming in. I'm Owen's English teacher.
Hale. Was Owen heard before that zero went in?
Be honest. On a scale of one to ten, how am I doing in this meeting?
I'm not grading you. You haven't answered me: did anyone speak to Owen first?
And what's one thing I could do better?
That's not my job. On what basis did you give my son a zero?
